old_caption: The video showcases a vibrant scene featuring a large number of colorful dominoes arranged on a light wooden floor. The dominoes are organized into a rainbow pattern, with colors transitioning from purple to blue, green, yellow, orange, red, and pink. Some dominoes stand upright while others lie flat, creating a textured surface. The dominoes begin to fall in a cascading effect, starting from the left side and moving towards the right. The sequence captures the chain reaction as each piece topples over the next, creating a mesmerizing visual effect with the colors blending as they tumble. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the entire scene.

caption: The video showcases a fixed high-angle view of a light wood floor arranged with dominoes. The upper half holds a fan-shaped spread of piles sorted into rainbow bands—purple, dark blue, light blue, green, yellow, orange, red, and pink—ringed by scattered loose pieces. A white braided cord rests at the far left, a transparent ruler lies horizontally across the middle, and short rows of white dominoes sit on the right, while several long serpentine lines of upright multicolored dominoes weave across the lower half. Within these foreground lines, a toppling wave is already underway and continues to advance during the clip. Sections that stand as neat vertical zigzags gradually flatten into diagonal, lying-down pieces, so the upright and fallen segments shift position along the wavy rows over time. The braided row and the line that loops back on the left both show this upright-to-flat transition creeping along their lengths. Meanwhile, the large rainbow piles behind them stay undisturbed in place, while the cord, ruler, and white rows remain unchanged under the still camera framing.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.

"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
